records.jp: 愛央は、不思議に思ったことはないか？<CR>なぜ、放送は、放送できるのだと
records.en_original: Have you ever thought about how amazing it is that things like these work?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever thought about how amazing it is that things like these work?
records.en: Ao, have you never wondered?<CR>Why broadcasting is able to broadcast?

records.jp: え、何？　何の話？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en: Huh? What do you mean?

records.jp: 蛇口を捻れば水が、電話をかければ声が……<CR>インターネットでは、世界と繋がれる
records.en_original: If you turn a tap, water comes out. If you call a phone, it rings. If you connect to the internet, you can talk to anyone in the world.
records.en_auxiliary: If you turn a tap, water comes out. If you call a phone, it rings. If you connect to the internet, you can talk to anyone in the world.
records.en: Turn a faucet and water comes out; make a phone call<CR>and a voice comes through... The internet connects you to the world.

records.jp: は、はあ……
records.en_original: R-right...
records.en_auxiliary: R-right...
records.en: R-right...

records.jp: きららは、常々気になっていた。<CR>それらの動力は、いったい何なのかと
records.en_original: I'm curious as to what allows these things to be possible.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm curious as to what allows these things to be possible.
records.en: Kirara has always wondered what<CR>power drives all those things.

records.jp: えーと……
records.en_original: Uhh...
records.en_auxiliary: Uhh...
records.en: Uhh...

records.jp: いやー、便利な世の中だよねー
records.en_original: Who knows, but it sure is a convenient age we live in!
records.en_auxiliary: Who knows, but it sure is a convenient age we live in!
records.en: What a convenient world we live in.

records.jp: うむ。だが、その便利。当たり前になりすぎて、<CR>大事なことを見逃しているような気がする
records.en_original: Agreed. However, this convenience has become so commonplace. I feel it's caused us to overlook something important.
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed. However, this convenience has become so commonplace. I feel it's caused us to overlook something important.
records.en: Indeed. But that convenience has become so ordinary<CR>that Kirara feels like we're overlooking something important.

records.jp: きららたちは、巨大な掌の上で<CR>踊らされているだけなのではないのかと
records.en_original: Sometimes I think that we're just puppets, dancing in the palm of something greater...
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes I think that we're just puppets, dancing in the palm of something greater...
records.en: Could Kirara and the others merely<CR>be made to dance in the palm of some enormous hand?

records.jp: えっ。陰謀のにおい！？
records.en_original: A conspiracy theory!
records.en_auxiliary: A conspiracy theory!
records.en: Wait, a conspiracy!?

records.jp: 変なこと気になるんだね？
records.en_original: You get caught up on the weirdest things...
records.en_auxiliary: You get caught up on the weirdest things...
records.en: You get caught up on the weirdest things...

records.jp: 変だから気になる。<CR>愛央は原材料不明のものを食べたいと思う？
records.en_original: They bother me because they are weird. You wouldn't eat something if you didn't know what was in it, would you?
records.en_auxiliary: They bother me because they are weird. You wouldn't eat something if you didn't know what was in it, would you?
records.en: Kirara wonders because it is strange.<CR>Would you want to eat something whose ingredients were unknown, Ao?

records.jp: それは、まあ……思わないけど
records.en_original: I...guess not...
records.en_auxiliary: I...guess not...
records.en: I...guess not...

records.jp: それと同じこと。<CR>世の中には、謎の動力が多すぎる
records.en_original: It's the same idea. This world is full of unknowns.
records.en_auxiliary: It's the same idea. This world is full of unknowns.
records.en: It's the same idea.<CR>This world has far too many mysterious power sources.

records.jp: ここは、実践してみるしかない
records.en_original: Our only option is to conduct a test.
records.en_auxiliary: Our only option is to conduct a test.
records.en: We have no choice but to try it ourselves.

records.jp: （放送してみたかっただけなんだ……）
records.en_original: (She just wanted to come up with an excuse to use the broadcasting equipment...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She just wanted to come up with an excuse to use the broadcasting equipment...)
records.en: (She just wanted to come up with an excuse to use the broadcasting equipment...)

records.jp: それじゃ、えーと、たしかこのボタンを押して、<CR>このレバーを上げれば……よし、出来た！
records.en_original: Right, first we push this button, then raise this lever, and... Bingo!
records.en_auxiliary: Right, first we push this button, then raise this lever, and... Bingo!
records.en: Right, first we push this button,<CR>then raise this lever, and... Bingo!

records.jp: マイクに向かって、何か喋って
records.en_original: Now just say something into the mic.
records.en_auxiliary: Now just say something into the mic.
records.en: Now just say something into the mic.

records.jp: ぐっどあふたぬーん、えぶりばでー。<CR>きららレイディオの時間なのだ
records.en_original: Good afternoon, everybody. Welcome to Kirara's radio hour.
records.en_auxiliary: Good afternoon, everybody. Welcome to Kirara's radio hour.
records.en: Good afternoon, everybody.<CR>It is time for Kirara Radio.

records.jp: （お！　良い感じじゃん！）
records.en_original: (Wow, she's good!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wow, she's good!)
records.en: (Wow, she's good!)

records.jp: 今日ゲストに<CR>愛央さんがきてくれています
records.en_original: Today we have a very special guest: Ms. Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: Today we have a very special guest: Ms. Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en: Today,<CR>Ao-san has come to join Kirara as a guest.

records.jp: あ、どもでーす！
records.en_original: Ah, hey everyone!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, hey everyone!
records.en: Ah, hey everyone!

records.jp: ……それでは、第一問。デデン！
records.en_original: All right, first question!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, first question!
records.en: Then, the first question. Deden!

records.jp: いきなり、クイズ番組！？
records.en_original: Wait, this is a quiz show?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, this is a quiz show?!
records.en: Wait, this is a quiz show?!

records.jp: フラミンゴの身体が赤いのは、エサに含まれる成分が<CR>影響していると言われていますが……
records.en_original: It is said that flamingos get their pink color from pigments found in their food.
records.en_auxiliary: It is said that flamingos get their pink color from pigments found in their food.
records.en: It is said that a flamingo's body is red<CR>because of substances contained in its food...

records.jp: その成分とは「ベータカロテン」と、何？
records.en_original: One of these pigments is beta-carotene. What is the other pigment?
records.en_auxiliary: One of these pigments is beta-carotene. What is the other pigment?
records.en: One of these pigments is beta-carotene. What is the other pigment?

records.jp: えぇっ！？
records.en_original: Wha—?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?!
records.en: Wha—?!

records.jp: 全然分かんないけど……<CR>ビタミンＣとか？
records.en_original: Uhh... I dunno. Erm, vitamin C? Maybe?
records.en_auxiliary: Uhh... I dunno. Erm, vitamin C? Maybe?
records.en: I have absolutely no idea...<CR>Vitamin C, maybe?

records.jp: ……本当にそれでいい？
records.en_original: Is that your final answer?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that your final answer?
records.en: Is that your final answer?

records.jp: ……うん。信じるよ、ビタミンＣ！
records.en_original: Yeah! I've made my choice!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! I've made my choice!
records.en: ...Yeah. I believe in you, vitamin C!

records.jp: ベータだから……アルファカロテンとか？
records.en_original: Hmm... You said beta, right? So how about alpha-carotene?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... You said beta, right? So how about alpha-carotene?
records.en: Hmm... You said beta, right? So how about alpha-carotene?

records.jp: ほう、なるほど……そう来ましたか
records.en_original: Hoho, I see.
records.en_auxiliary: Hoho, I see.
records.en: Ohh, I see... So that's how you're playing this.

records.jp: ……テレフォン使わなくていいですか？
records.en_original: Would you like to phone a friend?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you like to phone a friend?
records.en: ...Would you like to use a phone-a-friend?

records.jp: 使ったところで分かる人いないって
records.en_original: Like any of my friends would know...
records.en_auxiliary: Like any of my friends would know...
records.en: Like any of my friends would know...

records.en_original: The correct answer is...
records.en_auxiliary: The correct answer is...
records.en: Hmm... Hmm...

records.jp: 正解は「カンタキサンチン」！！
records.en_original: Canthaxanthin!
records.en_auxiliary: Canthaxanthin!
records.en: Canthaxanthin!

records.jp: いや、知らないし！<CR>思いついた答えの候補にすらなかった
records.en_original: Cantha—what?! That wasn't even one of my maybes!
records.en_auxiliary: Cantha—what?! That wasn't even one of my maybes!
records.en: How would I know that!? It<CR>wasn't even among the answers I considered!

records.jp: 残念ながら、愛央さんのスーパーきららは<CR>没収となります……ダララーン！
records.en_original: Unfortunately, a wrong answer means you're disqualified from the Super Kirara Quiz Corner. Too bad!
records.en_auxiliary: Unfortunately, a wrong answer means you're disqualified from the Super Kirara Quiz Corner. Too bad!
records.en: Unfortunately, Ao-san's Super Kirara will be confiscated...<CR>Dara-raan!

records.jp: 「スーパーきらら」ってなに……
records.en_original: The Super Kirara Quiz Corner...?
records.en_auxiliary: The Super Kirara Quiz Corner...?
records.en: What is a 'Super Kirara'...?

records.jp: さて、名残惜しいですが<CR>今回のきららレイディオは、ここまで！
records.en_original: Unfortunately that's all we've got time for. Tune in next time, to Kirara's Radio Hour!
records.en_auxiliary: Unfortunately that's all we've got time for. Tune in next time, to Kirara's Radio Hour!
records.en: Sadly, it's time to say goodbye.<CR>That's all for this episode of Kirara Radio!

records.jp: みなさん、また来週。<CR>しーゆーねくすとたーいむ！
records.en_original: See you next week. Keep safe!
records.en_auxiliary: See you next week. Keep safe!
records.en: Everyone, see you next week.<CR>See you next time!

records.jp: ふうー。きららとしたことが、<CR>少し緊張した
records.en_original: Whew... I hope I did well.
records.en_auxiliary: Whew... I hope I did well.
records.en: Whew...<CR>Even Kirara got a little nervous.

records.jp: きらら、今の放送だけどさ……
records.en_original: So about that announcement...
records.en_auxiliary: So about that announcement...
records.en: So about that announcement...

records.jp: 正直ちょっと、わけがわからなかった
records.en_original: The heck was that?
records.en_auxiliary: The heck was that?
records.en: Honestly, I had no idea what that was.

records.jp: な、なかなかの出来だと思ったのに……！
records.en_original: I-I thought it was rather good, myself.
records.en_auxiliary: I-I thought it was rather good, myself.
records.en: I-I thought it was rather good, myself.

records.jp: あ、でもそこがよかった！<CR>変なノリがあってさ
records.en_original: I did like how dumb it was!
records.en_auxiliary: I did like how dumb it was!
records.en: Ah, but that's what made it fun!<CR>It had this weird energy to it.

records.jp: 変なノリ……
records.en_original: Dumb...?
records.en_auxiliary: Dumb...?
records.en: Dumb...?

records.jp: きらら、自分でやっといて落ち込まないで！？
records.en_original: Wait, don't look so sad!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, don't look so sad!
records.en: Wait, don't look so sad!

records.jp: なんか、めちゃくちゃだったけど<CR>楽しかったよ
records.en_original: I didn't really get what was happening, but I had fun!
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't really get what was happening, but I had fun!
records.en: I didn't really get what was happening,<CR>but I had fun!

records.jp: ふむ……どうやらきららには<CR>ラジオパーソナリティの才能もあるとみた
records.en_original: Heheh. It appears that I have the potential to become a radio DJ.
records.en_auxiliary: Heheh. It appears that I have the potential to become a radio DJ.
records.en: Hm...<CR>It seems Kirara has a talent for radio too.

records.jp: なにより、愛央が楽しかったなら<CR>それが一番
records.en_original: But more importantly, I am glad that you enjoyed yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: But more importantly, I am glad that you enjoyed yourself.
records.en: But more importantly, if Ao had fun,<CR>that's what matters most.

records.jp: 愛央、第二回目の放送もよろしく
records.en_original: I can count on you for episode two, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I can count on you for episode two, right?
records.en: I can count on you for episode two, right?

records.jp: えっ、またやるの！？
records.en_original: You're gonna do more?!
records.en_auxiliary: You're gonna do more?!
records.en: You're gonna do more?!

records.jp: もちろん。きららたちの放送、<CR>もっと飛ばしていく
records.en_original: Of course. I'm hoping to make it big with this.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. I'm hoping to make it big with this.
records.en: Of course.<CR>Kirara and the others will send their broadcast even farther.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
